decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (a seeded deterministic baseline) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.0925. Series context: trend strength 0.7865 and seasonal strength 0.9834; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.305.
